# surveyverse <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="139" alt="" />

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/JDenn0514/surveyverse/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/JDenn0514/surveyverse/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/JDenn0514/surveyverse/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/JDenn0514/surveyverse)
<!-- badges: end -->

The surveyverse is a collection of R packages for survey research, sharing a
common design philosophy, grammar, and data structures. Install and load all
core packages with a single call to `library(surveyverse)`.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("JDenn0514/surveyverse")
```

## Usage

```{r example, eval = FALSE}
library(surveyverse)
#> -- Attaching core surveyverse packages --------
#> v surveycore    0.2.0
#> v surveytidy    0.1.0
#> v surveyweights 0.0.0.9000
```
